Priya Rao: Follow-up to the CP-separation RFC: we need a clear fallback story for control-plane maintenance windows (planned or unplanned) for private endpoints. Ops want deterministic behavior and a minimal-privacy-impact path.
Riley: Can we define "maintenance" vs "partition" in the runbook? operationally the actions differ.
Samir: quick defs I use: 
- maintenance: CP marked read-only / draining, we can still hit control-plane for auth but not for writes
- partition: control-plane unreachable from tenant VPC (peering/route issue)
AJ: TL;DR: maintenance -> graceful handoff, partition -> network fallback. both need observability and a safe default.
Maria Chen: Security constraint: many tenants forbids metadata exposure on egress. fallback must preserve tenant wire-level identity where possible.
Priya Rao: Proposal: two-mode fallback policy per-tenant: `termination_allowed: true|false` and `passthrough_preference: regional|peer|none`. Default: termination_allowed=false for new private endpoints.
Riley: Implementation sketch: 
1) CP enters maintenance -> controlplane publishes `maintenance:v=timestamp` to routing topic
2) Edge proxies read topic and pre-warm TLS sessions and KV caches for tenants that allow termination
3) On partition detection (health probes fail), edge proxies switch to `passthrough` or `terminate` based on tenant policy
Samir: For partition detection we should avoid CP heartbeats alone (false positives). Add an out-of-band relay probe: a small TCP probe from edge -> relay in tenant region. probe must be independent of CP auth flow.
AJ: Good. Add guards: do not auto-terminate for tenants with `termination_allowed=false`. Instead route to customer-designated peer if available, otherwise escalate to oncall.
Maria Chen: TLS/certs: if we do passthrough we can preserve SNI, but that means the upstream origin must have tenant certs or we need SNI-based routing at our regional ingress which sees SNI (privacy leak). If termination, we must serve tenant certs ourselves (mTLS) or use short-lived leaf certs provisioned by CP. But during partition CP might be unreachable to get new certs.
Priya Rao: Workaround: pre-provision ephemeral fallback certs during onboarding and rotate them out-of-band. Add `fallback_cert` with `valid_until` metadata in tenant record.
Riley: Runbook snippet for ops when partition detected:
```
# detect
curl -fsS https://routing.health/internal/tenants/{id}/probe || echo "probe-fail"
# trigger failover (manual)
POST https://controlplane.internal/tenants/{id}/routing/override -d '{"mode":"regional_passthrough"}' 
# revert
POST https://controlplane.internal/tenants/{id}/routing/override -d '{"mode":"auto"}'
```
Samir: Observability: emit `routing.fallback.invoked` with tags {tenant_id, reason, chosen_mode}. add a histogram for `fallback.time_to_steady_state`. also surface per-tenant `termination_allowed` in Console.
AJ: API design: I can own `PATCH /tenants/{id}` to accept `fallback_policy` block: `{ "termination_allowed": bool, "fallback_priority": ["peer","regional_passthrough","shared_terminate"] }`. Must be auditable and require two-person approval for flipping `termination_allowed` from false->true for enterprise tenants.
Maria Chen: Privacy: shared_terminate path MUST scrub headers `X-Tenant-Id`, `X-Org-Metadata`, and strip JWTs. Add an explicit policy test that fails if header scrubber misconfigured.
Priya Rao: QA plan: run matrix in staging for combos: termination_allowed true/false, peer configured/absent, simulate CP maintenance vs partition, simulate cert expiry, simulate NAT exhaustion. Riley will coordinate.
Riley: I'll add a test harness that spins up a local relay and toggles `maintenance` flag. test script will assert no tenant-id visible on shared egress.
Samir: Ops checklist for planned maintenance: pre-warm certs, run `probe` sweep, ensure `fallback_metric` baseline < 1% errors. For unplanned partition: auto-sample 1% of traffic and route to regional_passthrough for 60s as a canary.
AJ: Billing/SLA note: fallback to shared_terminate may have cost implications. emit `fallback.billing.code` and include in monthly usage report for SLA credits.
infra-bot: scheduled_maint: controlplane will be read-only 2026-04-07 02:00-02:30 UTC - see https://go/release-notes (automated) :calendar:
Priya Rao: Action items: Samir -> implement relay probe + health topic (ETA Thu), AJ -> API schema + audit event (ETA Fri), Riley -> staging test harness (ETA next Tue), Maria -> security checklist for cert fallback (ETA Fri). I'll draft a one-page runbook after those land.
Riley: one more: add a graceful rollback rule: if regional_passthrough increases 5xx by >3% within 3m, revert to previous routing and page SRE.
Samir: I'll include port-saturation checks in probe outputs (NAT exhaustion signal).
Priya Rao: Great. We'll converge on language in the runbook PR. Thanks all :thumbsup:
